sentences.en: Steel production of the year was the highest on record.
sentences.zh: 这一年钢铁产量创历史新高。

sentences.en: Concrete can be reinforced by putting steel bars inside it.
sentences.zh: 在混凝土中放入钢筋可以增强其强度。

sentences.en: The sword is banded with steel to make it stronger.
sentences.zh: 剑上嵌有钢条以使其更坚固。

senses.zh: 钢，钢铁；钢制品，钢铁制品；钢铁般的意志，坚强
